title: Back Extension Machine (Selectorized)
summary: A seated selectorized back extension that trains the lower back directly with very little load on the hips.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: commercial gym machine (this exercise's own machine).

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for lower back (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly lower back total.
Library rating 0.4 for glutes (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.3 for hamstrings (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly hamstrings total.

setup.text: Sit with the pad across your upper back and your feet braced.
Extend your spine back against the pad.

form_cues.cue: Move through a comfortable range. Don't snap into extension.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less isolation, Less stable.
Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, Less lower-back work, Peak-contraction focus.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less lower-back work, Less isolation.
